items.hk: ReraRO yatkarma RO cet sa kartA'nADyAne
items.iast: ṇe raṇau yat karma ṇau cet sa kartā 'nādhyāne
prahāse ca manya-upapade manyater uttama ekavac ca
yasmād adhikaṃ yasya ca+īśvara-vacanaṃ tatra saptamī

items.hk: karmaRi ca yena saMsparSAt kartuH SarIrasuKam
items.iast: karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśāt kartuḥ śarīra-sukham

items.hk: kriyAsamaBihAre low; lowo hisvO; vA ca taDvamoH
items.iast: kriyāsam-abhihāre loṭ loṭo hi-svau vā ca ta-dhvamoḥ
laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve ca akramakebhyaḥ
tad asyāṃ praharaṇam iti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ
tad asminn asti iti deśe tannāmni

items.hk: janapadinAM janapadavat sarvaM janapadena samAnaSabdAnAM bahuvacane
items.iast: janapadināṃ janapadavat sarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane

items.hk: tadvAnAsAmupaDAno mantra itIzwakAsu luk ca matoH
items.iast: tadvān āsām upadhāno mantra iti iṣṭakāsu luk ca matoḥ
tad asya tad asmin syād iti
tad dharati vahavty āvahati bhārād vaṃśādibhyaḥ
tad asminn adhikam iti daśāntāḍ ḍaḥ
tad asya asty asminn iti matup
pādaśatasya saṅkhyāder vīpsāyāṃ vun lopaś ca
añ nāsikāyāḥ sañjñāyāṃ nasaṃ ca asthūlāt
viṣvag-devayoś ca ṭer adry añcatau vapratyaye
sanaḥ ktici lopaś ca asya anyatarasyām
sya-sic-sīyuṭ-tāsiṣu bhāva-karmaṇor upadeśe 'j-jhana-graha-dṛśāṃ vā ciṇvad-iṭ ca

items.hk: na yvAByAM padAntAByAm pUrvO tu tAByAmEc
items.iast: na y-vābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyām aic
pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasya ata id āpy asupaḥ
gatyartha-loṭā lṛṇ na cet kārakaṃ sarvānyat

items.hk: radAByAM nizWAto naH pUrvasya ca daH
items.iast: ra-dābhyāṃ niṣthāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ
eco 'pragṛhyasya adūrādhdūte pūrvasya ardhasya ad uttarasya+idutau
